literal: The beloved one does not bestow love, even though, concerning him, even the sound is sweet to the ear.
translation: Even though my beloved does not bestow his grace upon me, any word or news concerning him is sweet to my ears.
modern: என் அன்பிற்குரியவர் எனக்கு அருள் செய்யவில்லை என்றாலும், அவரைப் பற்றிய செய்தியும் பேச்சும் என் காதுகளுக்கு இனிமையாக இருக்கின்றன.
explanation: The heroine, suffering from the pain of separation, expresses her deep love. Even though her beloved does not return to show his grace (nalkār), any sound, word, or news (icai) coming from him or concerning him is sweet to her ears. The word 'icai' here refers to the sound of his name or news about him. This shows that for a true lover, even the mere mention of the beloved brings comfort, despite their painful absence.
